strategy.summary: Reproduce the convergence defect in ElasticNet with alpha=0 (no L1 penalty) where coordinate descent's dual-gap stopping rule is invalid, so CD does not converge and test_enet_ols_consistency fails on the buggy commit 4be3e7dd5826 but passes after the PR #32845 fix. Build scikit-learn from the buggy revision with Cython so the change in sklearn/linear_model/_cd_fast.pyx takes effect, then run the developer's test file with the parametrized test_enet_ols_consistency.

system_packages: libopenblas-dev (OpenBLAS 0.3.25 pthreads, Haswell target if reproducible)
C/C++ compiler toolchain able to build scikit-learn extensions
build_commands: pip install -r build_tools/requirements.txt or pip install numpy scipy Cython joblib threadpoolctl pytest pandas matplotlib
pinned_because: numpy and scipy are documented only as >= minimum versions (minimum not stated in passages); upper bounds are era-inferred from the PR date (2025-12-31), so the strategy relies on era inference for the ceiling, not documentation
Cython ceiling is era-inferred (<=3.0) and only needed to rebuild _cd_fast.pyx; the reporter used Cython 3.1.2, so a Cython 3.1.x build may be needed if 3.0 fails to compile
joblib, threadpoolctl, matplotlib, setuptools, pip are unbounded: no documented constraint and no era entry, so this plan chooses current compatible releases and states that choice
pandas ceiling is era-inferred and not required by the test

strategy.reproducing_test: sklearn/linear_model/tests/test_coordinate_descent.py::test_enet_ols_consistency (parametrized over precompute in {False, True} and effective_rank in {None, 10}, run across global random seeds)
strategy.success_criterion: On buggy commit 4be3e7dd5826, with SKLEARN_TESTS_GLOBAL_RANDOM_SEED=all, test_enet_ols_consistency fails for some seeds (e.g. [42-10-False], [59-None-True]) because the squared-error ordering or the absolute-tolerance coefficient/intercept assertion breaks. On the fixed revision (PR #32845), the same command passes for all seeds and parametrizations.
strategy.numerical_probe: Compare se_enet and se_ols for precompute=False, effective_rank=10, seed 42, and check whether CD stops before convergence at alpha=0 with tol=1e-15.
risks: Failure is seed-dependent and only appears for particular global random seeds; a single default-seed run may pass on the buggy revision, so the SKLEARN_TESTS_GLOBAL_RANDOM_SEED=all run is required.

Assertions near 1e-20 to 1e-26 are sensitive to floating-point round-off and BLAS backend; the reporter used OpenBLAS 0.3.25 Haswell with pthreads, which may not be reproduced on other architectures (e.g. ARM or different OpenBLAS targets), so the transition may not occur there.
The reporter's numpy 1.24.1 and scipy 1.10.0 are not documented minimums; running with newer numpy/scipy within era ceilings may change the rounding and remove the failure.

The fixed test file also changes other tests (ridge consistency, warnings, sparse equality); the -k filter isolates test_enet_ols_consistency but the buggy revision may still show differences in other tests the grader does not select.
The test relies on the 'With alpha=0, this algorithm' UserWarning filter; if the buggy revision emits a different warning text, filterwarnings may not match and the failure mode may differ.
Iteration count at which CD stops, max_iter, and coefficient initialisation are not stated in the evidence, so the exact non-convergence point is not confirmed.
Building from source requires a compiler and OpenMP; if libomp is missing or mismatched, the build may fail or silently fall back to a different threading configuration, changing the outcome.
Behaviour depends on whether the dual gap formulation (fix) is compiled into the extension; a stale build of _cd_fast from another revision would invalidate the transition.

oracle.tolerance: assert_allclose atol=1e-11 for coef_, atol=1e-12 for intercept_, and absolute squared-error bounds 1e-20
oracle.why: The test compares against LinearRegression with absolute tolerances and squared-error bounds; the buggy CD solver fails these assertions for certain seeds.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: On the buggy revision, ElasticNet(alpha=0, tol=1e-15) does not converge because the dual gap is invalid at alpha=0, so the squared-error ordering se_enet <= se_ols fails (e.g. 7.30e-26 <= 6.72e-26) or the absolute coef/intercept tolerances are violated, raising AssertionError.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: With the PR #32845 dual_gap_formulation_A in _cd_fast.pyx, CD converges for alpha=0, predictions and coefficients match OLS within atol, and the squared-error bounds hold, so the test passes across seeds.
